verdict.rationale: The only evidence touching this story is that the Cloud Agents API accepts a prompt with text plus up to 5 images. Separately, agents can build, test and demo features end to end. Together these imply image-informed code generation, but no documentation describes turning a design, sketch or mockup into a working app. missing for 10: documented design/sketch/image-to-app workflow, PDF design input support, examples or hands-on corroboration that image designs produce working apps.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can generate a working app from a sketch, image, or PDF design

citations.quote: Agents use their own computers to build, test, and demo features end to end for you to review.
